# 41 Hardinge Road, Liverpool L19 4UN

This is a three-bedroom semi-detached freehold family home marketed at offers over £265,000. It includes a living room, separate dining room, fitted kitchen, ground-floor shower room, first-floor family bathroom and three bedrooms. The approximate floor area is 96.6 m² / 1,040 sq ft. The rear garden includes a paved patio and lawn.

The supplied property information places Liverpool South Parkway about 0.5 miles away, West Allerton about 0.6 miles away and Cressington about 0.8 miles away. Springwood Heath Primary School is listed at about 0.3 miles. Other supplied local references include Calderstones Park, Otterspool Promenade, Allerton Road and Liverpool John Lennon Airport. Distances, school admissions, catchment details, price and availability must be confirmed independently.

The selling agent is Entwistle Green - Allerton Sales. Viewings can be requested by calling 0151 453 3741. The office telephone is 01513 827414.
